name_note: The genomes GTDB places in Brotaphodocola carry older NCBI names such as Clostridium and Ventrimonas, so papers may use those names.

sentences.text: Brotaphodocola is a bacterial taxon detected by 16S rRNA gene sequencing of human faecal samples.
A study of women living in Puerto Rico reported Brotaphodocola among taxa preferentially associated with controls rather than with polycystic ovary syndrome.
Brotaphodocola has also been measured in studies of the intestinal flora of broiler chickens.
